3. **Consult multiple sources**: Don't rely on a single source to verify the claim. This will help you get a more comprehensive understanding of the issue and reduce the likelihood of spreading misinformation.

Remember to approach sensational claims with skepticism and verify information before sharing it to avoid perpetuating misinformation and harm to minority groups.
